usages.usage: 在 worries go away 中，go away 表示感覺或問題消失，不是真的走去某處。
在 light packer 和 light traveler 中，light 表示帶很少東西、行李不多。

breakdowns.sentence: Whenever I go to the airport, I just pray I didn't forget one tiny detail.
breakdowns.translation: 每次我去機場時，我就祈禱自己沒有忘記某個小細節。

points.label: Whenever 引導時間副詞子句
points.text: Whenever + 主詞 + 動詞, 主詞 + 動詞
points.note: Whenever 表示每一次發生某事時，後面接一個完整子句，再接主要句子。

breakdowns.sentence: One tiny detail that could make me miss my flight.
breakdowns.translation: 一個可能讓我錯過班機的小細節。

points.label: 關係子句 that + 情態助動詞 could
points.text: 名詞 + that + could + 動詞原形
points.note: that could make me miss my flight 用來補充說明 detail，表示這個細節可能造成的結果。

breakdowns.sentence: I check in right away so that I have more peace of mind.
breakdowns.translation: 我馬上辦理登機手續，這樣我就能更安心。

points.label: so that 表目的或結果
points.text: 主句 + so that + 主詞 + 動詞
points.note: so that 後面接一個子句，說明做前面那件事的目的或帶來的結果。

breakdowns.sentence: I think it is less stressful to check in online than it is to check in in person.
breakdowns.translation: 我覺得線上辦理登機手續比親自辦理壓力小。

points.label: 比較級 less ... than ...
points.text: It is less + 形容詞 + to V + than + it is + to V
points.note: 用 less stressful than 比較兩件事，表示前者的壓力比後者小。

breakdowns.sentence: Finding my gate is usually less stressful than going through security.
breakdowns.translation: 找登機門通常比通過安檢壓力小。

points.label: 動名詞作主詞與比較
points.text: V-ing + is + 比較級 + than + V-ing
points.note: Finding 和 going 都是動名詞，當作事情來比較。

breakdowns.sentence: But once I am at my gate, my worries go away.
breakdowns.translation: 一旦我到了登機門，我的擔心就消失了。

points.label: once 引導時間子句
points.text: Once + 主詞 + 動詞, 主詞 + 動詞
points.note: once 在這裡表示一旦某事發生，另一件事就跟著發生。

breakdowns.sentence: My flights rarely get delayed, but when they do, it is very annoying.
breakdowns.translation: 我的班機很少延誤，但一延誤就很煩。

points.label: 助動詞 do 代替前面的動作
points.note: do 代替前面提到的 get delayed，避免重複整個動詞片語。

breakdowns.sentence: Airports also give me that nervous excitement, that feeling of butterflies in my stomach, butterflies for all the adventures to come.
breakdowns.translation: 機場也給我那種為了即將到來的冒險而緊張興奮的感覺。

points.label: 名詞 + to V 作後位修飾
points.text: 名詞 + to + 動詞原形
points.note: to come 放在 adventures 後面，表示那些冒險是未來即將發生的。

breakdowns.sentence: I used to have long layovers.
breakdowns.translation: 我以前常常有很長的轉機等待時間。

points.label: used to 表過去習慣
points.text: 主詞 + used to + 動詞原形
points.note: used to 表示以前常常做某事，但現在可能不再這樣。

breakdowns.sentence: I wanted to save money, as much money as I possibly could.
breakdowns.translation: 我想省錢，盡可能省越多錢越好。

points.label: as ... as 比較結構
points.text: as + much + 名詞 + as + 主詞 + could
points.note: 這個結構表示程度盡可能高，as much money as I possibly could 就是盡可能多省錢。

breakdowns.sentence: I would book flights as long as 52 hours with 12-hour layovers.
breakdowns.translation: 我會訂長達 52 小時、包含 12 小時轉機等待的航班。

points.label: would 表過去反覆習慣
points.text: 主詞 + would + 動詞原形
points.note: would 在這裡不是未來，而是回憶過去常做的事。

breakdowns.sentence: What has been your longest layover?
breakdowns.translation: 你到目前為止最長的轉機等待是多久？

points.label: 現在完成式疑問句
points.text: What + has + 過去分詞 + 名詞?
points.note: has been 用來問到現在為止的人生經驗或紀錄。

breakdowns.sentence: Would you rather have a cheap 52-hour flight or an expensive 12-hour flight?
breakdowns.translation: 你寧願搭便宜的 52 小時航班，還是昂貴的 12 小時航班？

points.label: would rather 表偏好
points.text: Would + 主詞 + rather + 動詞原形 + A or B?
points.note: would rather 用來詢問或表達比較想要哪一個選項。
